'''Elja and Munusia''', officially the '''Federal Republic of Elja and Munusia''', is a country on the northern coast of [[New Ayre]] that identifies with the [[Demeeri]] and was once part of the historic Easuhuran Demeeris. [[Su Hitan]] and [[Mishig]] are both the capital of Elja and Munusia, with the latter being the country's largest city. Elja and Munusia are bordered by the [[Northern Eanif Ocean]] to the north, and [[Maalle]] to the south and east.

With a land area of [[List of countries and dependencies by area|11,432 km2 (4,414 sq mi)]], Elja and Munusia is the 151st largest sovereign state by area, and is the [[List of countries and dependencies by population|154th least populous sovereign state]]. The official language of the country is Easuhuran, although a large part of the population is [[wikipedia:Multilingualism|bilingual]] in [[Easuhuran language|Easuhuran]] and the indigenous languages. Elja and Munusia are the only countries in mainland [[New Ayre]] to have [[Easuhura|Easuhuran]] as the official language. The majority of the population also speaks [[Easuhuran Creole]], which is an Easuhuran-based creole, maintaining strong cultural, historical, and political ties with other Easuhuran. 

It has a wide variety of natural habitats and very [[wikipedia:Biodiversity|high biodiversity]]. The country also hosts a part of the [[Seroasa rainforest]], the one of the largest and most biodiverse [[wikipedia:Tropical_rainforest|tropical rainforests]] in the world. The region known as "the Demeeri" consists of the large shield landmass. Historically dominated by the [[Munusia tribe]], [[Elja]] is the native name for Easuhurans, who colonised the land in the early 15th century. It was governed as the [[Dano colony]] with a mostly [[wikipedia:Plantation|plantation-style economy]] until the 1720s. It gained independence in 1734 and officially became a Federal republic. The legacy of [[Emaran colonialism]] is reflected in the country's political administration, lingua franca and divided population.
